nom: La Roche-Posay, Toleriane, Gel Moussant Purifiant, Nettoie Apaise et Démaquille, Adapté aux Peaux Sensibles à Réactives, Sans Parfum, Composition Hypoallergénique et Non Comédogène, 400 ml

avis.titre: Très bien mais ne démaquille pas.
avis.texte: J’ai acheté l’article car je lave mon visage avec le cicaplast lavant de la roche posay. J’avais envie de tester un démaquillant. Il mousse bien. Nettoie la peau mais on ne peut pas dire qu’il démaquille (et mon maquillage n’est pas waterproof). Ou alors c’est laborieux. Pour autant il n’achète pas la peau. C’est malgré tout un bon produit. Peu de liquide suffise pour qu’il nettoie la peau. N’assèche pas. Je recommanderai le produit.
J’adore cette marque je m’en sert à chaque douche pour nettoyer le visage acheter et racheter !!

avis.titre: Résultat visible en quelques jours, peau apaisée
avis.texte: Pour l’instant j’apprécie la sensation sur mon visage, 40 ans dans quelques mois et une peau qui a besoin de ne pas être agressée
This product would last an entire year because you just need a little to wash your face
Au top, je n'ai jamais eu la peau aussi douce après utilisation.

avis.titre: La Roche Posay Toleriane is such a good find
avis.texte: I’ve been using the La Roche-Posay Toleriane Hydrating Gentle Cleanser 400ml and honestly, it’s been such a good find. It cleans my face really well without leaving it feeling tight or stripped, which is something I struggle with when it comes to cleansers. My skin feels fresh, soft, and comfortable after every wash—not dry at all. I also love that it comes in a 400ml bottle, so it lasts long and is definitely value for money. Overall, it’s a gentle but effective cleanser, especially if you want something that keeps your skin clean while still maintaining moisture.

avis.titre: Great brand and productGreat brand and product
avis.texte: Purchased this as I am revamping my skincare products based on ingredients that are not harmful. This product gets an excellent rating via the Yuka app of 79/100 vs my dermatologist approved former product (Riversol) that was rated poor. I’ve been using this product for one week and so far I am very satisfied with the results. A little goes a long way so this will last me quite a while. 1/2 a pump is enough for my entire face and neck area. The pump bottle is also a plus. So convenient. It is less expensive than what I was paying for my previous product. It has a non-smell that smells very pleasant and fresh. It foams wonderfully and rinses clean with no residual residue. Leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh and not tight or dry. After 30 days of use I will update this rating to add details about any pore reducing effects or other noticeable observations. So far 10/10 and am loving the product.
Really good - unscented. A little goes a long way. Gentle and non irritating on the skin.
The Toleraine foaming gel is really good and perfect for my oily skin. It is not stripping and doesn't make the face dry afterwards. I'm pleased with the product.
